name: GL_IMPORT_REFERENCES
description: GL_IMPORT_REFERENCES contains individual transactions from subledgers that have been summarized into Oracle General Ledger journal entry lines through the Journal Import process. You can specify the journal entry sources for which you want to maintain your transaction's origin by entering 'Yes' in the Import Journal References field of the Journal Sources definition. For each source that has Import Journal References set to 'Yes', Oracle General Ledger will populate GL_IMPORT_REFERENCES with one record for each transaction in your feeder system.

columns.name: JE_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Line number of the imported journal.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SUBLEDGER_DOC_SEQUENCE_ID
columns.description: Document sequence identifier for the journal to be imported.

columns.name: SUBLEDGER_DOC_SEQUENCE_VALUE
columns.description: Document sequence value for the journal to be imported.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PARTITION_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Partition grouping information which when combined with the period, determines the database partition in which this journal reference information will be stored.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Accounting period for the reference information.
